task_summary: Split the canonical formal-project audit's 'human review' readiness gate into TWO distinct booleans so the audit never emits the contradictory 'user can edit NOW' / 'don't start human review' pair at the same time. The 'human_review_input_ready' gate (= audit.human_review_ready; the flag --require-human-review-ready) is true at 0/150 once data, schema, tool, and v2 file are in place. The 'human_review_freeze_ready' gate (= v2 human_correction.freeze_ready; tracked in validate_human_correction.py) remains false until 150/150 adjudicated. Both states are reported separately; the old 'formal_human_review_paused' blocker is replaced by 'formal_gold_publication_paused'. No data is modified; no real LLM/API is called; no .env is read; no references/archive changes.

files_modified.role: Add two distinct readiness booleans: human_review_input_ready (true at 0/150) and human_review_freeze_ready (true at 150/150 adjudicated). human_review_ready is kept as a backward-compatible alias of human_review_input_ready. ready_for_final_metrics now requires human_review_freeze_ready. print_human prints both gates explicitly.

Rewrite the formal_human_review_paused blocker as two separate findings: a new PASS 'human_review_input_ready' (authorizes the user to start review NOW) and a new BLOCKER 'formal_gold_publication_paused' (scopes the pause to formal Gold only). The audit output now prints both 'Human review input ready' and 'Human review freeze ready' lines. Bumps audit_version to 3.1 and rewrites claim_boundary.

Replace the contradictory 'Do not start human Gold review until ... passes audit' boundary with the explicit two-gate description: input-ready does NOT require any record to be reviewed; freeze-ready is the precondition for declaring formal Gold.

Add a new section 5.1 '启动门禁 vs 冻结门禁' that defines the two gates, the expected value at 0/150, the expected value at 150/150 adjudicated, and the exact commands to check each gate. Header note records the 2026-07-13 11:30 split.

Add a 4.1.1 subsection under 4.1 that distinguishes the per-record cumulative review_ready / freeze_ready in the v2 human_correction file from the two audit-level gates (input-ready vs freeze-ready). Top of doc records the 2026-07-13 split.

Add user_decisions_2026_07_13_1130 block recording: two_gates_split=true, single_dataset_self_sampled_150_locked=true, not_sun_original_150=true, not_exact_reproduction=true, no_resampling=true, no_parallel_old_new_150=true, review_input_ready_at_0_150=true, review_freeze_ready_requires_150_150_adjudicated=true, with the exact commands for each gate. Also lists the removed blocker code and the new codes.

Replace the old 'paused' test with 7 new tests pinning down the two-gate split: (1) both booleans reported, (2) audit authorizes user to start review NOW, (3) old 'formal_human_review_paused' blocker removed, (4) new 'formal_gold_publication_paused' scoped to Gold only, (5) status exposes both booleans, (6) validate_human_correction CLI still shows review_ready=False / freeze_ready=False, (7) --require-human-review-ready exits 0 at 0/150, (8) --require-final-ready still fails at 0/150. Plus the 4 pre-existing governance tests kept.
